Topics.Topic: Primary Prevention of SCD in Patients With Nonischemic Cardiomyopathy
Key Points: Amiodarone is compared with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) for heart failure.
ICDs effectively reduce mortality in nonischemic cardiomyopathy patients.

Topics.Topic: Treatment of Recurrent VA in Patients With ICD
Key Points: Comparison of beta-blockers and sotalol for ICD patients.
Catheter ablation shows improvement in refractory cases.
Genetics and clinical management of arrhythmia in right ventricular cardiomyopathy.
Genotype-phenotype correlations and family screening are crucial.
